description: Score matrix/cytoplasmic salt-bridge networks and substrate contact points across SLC25 carriers vs MTCH1/2 orthologs
code:
import json, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
exec(open('aln.py').read())
ALL=json.load(open('seqs.json'))
AAC=ALL['AAC1_BOVIN']

# ---- reference feature sets, bovine AAC1 (UniProt P02722 numbering; mature = UniProt-1) ----
MATRIX = {  # three PX[DE]XX[KR] motifs: proline, acidic, basic
 'H1 P28':(28,'P'),'H1 E30':(30,'E'),'H1 K33':(33,'K'),
 'H3 P133':(133,'P'),'H3 D135':(135,'D'),'H3 R138':(138,'R'),
 'H5 P230':(230,'P'),'H5 D232':(232,'D'),'H5 R235':(235,'R')}
# cytoplasmic [FY][DE]XX[KR]: scan each repeat window for the best match
cy_hits=[]
for lo,hi in [(80,115),(185,215),(282,298)]:
    hs=[(m.start()+1,m.group(1)) for m in re.finditer(r'(?=([FY][DE]..[KR]))',AAC) if lo<=m.start()+1<=hi]
    cy_hits.append((lo,hi,hs))
print('cytoplasmic-motif scan by repeat window:',cy_hits)
CYTO = {'H2 Y195':(195,'Y'),'H2 D196':(196,'D'),'H2 K199':(199,'K'),
        'H6 Y291':(291,'Y'),'H6 D292':(292,'D'),'H6 K295':(295,'K')}
SUBSTR = {f'{AAC[p-1]}{p-1}':(p,AAC[p-1]) for p in [23,80,92,138,183,184,187,188,232,235,236,280]}
print('substrate contact points (mature numbering labels):',list(SUBSTR))

EQ={'K':'KR','R':'KR','D':'DE','E':'DE'}
def match(obs,exp):
    if obs=='-' or obs=='': return 0
    if obs==exp: return 1
    if exp in EQ and obs in EQ[exp]: return 1
    return 0

CANON=['AAC1_BOVIN','ANT1_HUMAN','AAC2_YEAST','UCP1_HUMAN','UCP2_HUMAN','UCP3_HUMAN','PIC_HUMAN',
       'CIC_HUMAN','CACT_HUMAN','ORNT1_HUMAN','GDC_HUMAN','DIC_HUMAN']
MT=[k for k in ALL if k.startswith('MTCH')]
order=CANON+sorted([k for k in MT if k.startswith('MTCH2')])+sorted([k for k in MT if k.startswith('MTCH1')])

feat = list(MATRIX.items())+list(CYTO.items())+list(SUBSTR.items())
rows=[];resgrid=[];hitgrid=[];aln_scores={}
for name in order:
    m,s,_,_ = ref_map(AAC, ALL[name]); aln_scores[name]=s
    res=[m.get(p,'-') for lbl,(p,e) in feat]
    hit=[match(m.get(p,'-'),e) for lbl,(p,e) in feat]
    resgrid.append(res); hitgrid.append(hit)
    nm=len(MATRIX); nc=len(CYTO); ns=len(SUBSTR)
    rows.append({'protein':name,'aln_score_vs_AAC1':s,
                 'matrix_net_9':sum(hit[:nm]),'cyto_net_6':sum(hit[nm:nm+nc]),
                 'substrate_12':sum(hit[nm+nc:]),'total_27':sum(hit)})
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
df['pct']=100*df['total_27']/27
pd.set_option('display.width',200)
print(); print(df.to_string(index=False))
df.to_csv('mtch2_carrier_motif_scores.csv',index=False)
pd.DataFrame(resgrid,index=order,columns=[l for l,_ in feat]).to_csv('mtch2_carrier_residue_grid.csv')

# ---- figure ----
H=np.array(hitgrid,float)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(14,8))
ax.imshow(H,cmap='RdYlGn',vmin=0,vmax=1,aspect='auto')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(feat))); ax.set_xticklabels([l for l,_ in feat],rotation=90,fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(order))); ax.set_yticklabels(order,fontsize=8)
for i in range(len(order)):
    for j in range(len(feat)):
        ax.text(j,i,resgrid[i][j],ha='center',va='center',fontsize=6)
for x in [len(MATRIX)-0.5,len(MATRIX)+len(CYTO)-0.5]:
    ax.axvline(x,color='k',lw=1.5)
ax.axhline(len(CANON)-0.5,color='k',lw=1.5)
ax.axhline(len(CANON)+len([k for k in MT if k.startswith('MTCH2')])-0.5,color='k',lw=1)
ax.set_title('Retention of bovine AAC1 carrier machinery (green = retained, red = lost)\n'
             'left: matrix PX[DE]XX[KR] network | middle: cytoplasmic [FY][DE]XX[KR] network | right: substrate contact points',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
